% HTN_CKD.1: If the patient has a hypertension and the patient has a chronic-kidney-disease then the code I12.9 is assigned and the code I10 is not assigned and the code I12.9 precedes the code N18.9.

% HTN_CKD.2: If the patient has a hypertension and the patient has a chronic-kidney-disease then the code I12.9 is assigned and the code I10 is not assigned and the code I12.9 precedes the code N18.9.

% SEQ_DX_FACTOR: If a code C is assigned and the code C is a factor code and a code D is assigned and the code D is a diagnosis code then the code D precedes the code C.

rules: If a person T is in the restricted-zone for at least 2 seconds then a zone-intrusion alert is raised for the person T.
If the person T holds a cell-phone for at least 3 seconds then a phone-use alert is raised for the person T.
If a person T is visible for at least 60 seconds then a long-presence alert is raised for the person T.
